name: A-Eval
description: A-Eval is a cross-dataset and cross-modality benchmark for abdominal multi-organ segmentation. It tests whether segmentation models trained on one dataset or modality generalize to other datasets and to both CT and MRI, highlighting domain shift and robustness issues in medical imaging.
evaluation_method: Segmentation metrics such as Dice coefficient and Hausdorff distance, aggregated across datasets and modalities
notes: Integrates seven datasets spanning CT and MRI and is designed specifically to study generalization gaps. The exact best reported score depends on organ, dataset, and modality; no single overall SOTA value is provided in the metadata.
